tagline.en: Tower, Pump, Keno, Tarot and Horse Racing each get their own place.
tagline.id: Tower, Pump, Keno, Tarot, dan Horse Racing punya tempatnya sendiri.

items.en: Tower: a castle keep under the stars with stone blocks and explosions. Pump: a carnival tent with a real pump.
items.id: Tower: menara kastil di bawah bintang dengan balok batu dan ledakan. Pump: tenda karnaval dengan pompa sungguhan.

items.en: Keno: a lottery machine full of bouncing balls. Tarot: a candle-lit fortune table. Horse Racing: a stadium with real racehorses.
items.id: Keno: mesin lotre penuh bola memantul. Tarot: meja ramalan diterangi lilin. Horse Racing: stadion dengan kuda pacu sungguhan.
